issues.summary: Database connection pool exhaustion under load
issues.description: Connection pool leaks observed during high concurrency testing. Max pool size reached after 20 minutes under 500 RPS load.

issues.summary: BLOCKER: Third-party EHR Sandbox API returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts
issues.blocker_details: Critical blocker: Upstream hospital partner sandbox API is failing with 504 timeouts. Blocks all live integration tests and FHIR parser validation.
issues.description: External partner EHR sandbox environment has been returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors intermittently since Sunday morning. Reported to vendor support (Ticket #VEND-8821). Until resolved, live FHIR connector validation is completely blocked.

issues.summary: BLOCKER: AWS KMS Customer-Managed Key rotation failure in staging
issues.blocker_details: Critical blocker: Staging KMS key rotation policy causes AccessDeniedException when decrypting tenant credentials, halting automated CI tests.
issues.description: Automated annual key rotation policy triggered an IAM policy conflict where the service role lost Decrypt permissions on rotated key versions. All staging database decrypt operations fail.

issues.summary: Migrate authentication service to OIDC identity provider
issues.deadline_change_details: Deadline updated last week from Oct 18 to Nov 01 due to IdP configuration issue and claim mapping adjustments.
issues.description: Transition legacy session tokens to OpenID Connect JWT tokens with OAuth2 scopes. Due date shifted back 2 weeks last week.
Parser achieved 4,200 records/sec throughput, exceeding the 2,500 records/sec SLA requirement.

issues.summary: Implement circuit breaker and retry for EHR webhooks
issues.deadline_change_details: Deadline updated last week from Oct 22 to Nov 05 to accommodate webhook replay safeguards and exponential backoff testing.
issues.description: Add resilience circuit breaker using Tenacity to shield the backend against cascading failures from partner webhooks. Deadline was extended last week.

issues.description: Bumped python cryptography library to fix CVE-2024-XXXX; vulnerability scanner passed.
